{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values and sentinel values
print("Missing values in customer_age:", sales_df['customer_age'].isnull().sum())
print("Sentinel value -1 occurrences in customer_age:", (sales_df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check the distribution of customer_age
print("\nSummary statistics for customer_age:")
print(sales_df['customer_age'].describe())

# Check how many unique values there are and their counts
print("\nValue counts for customer_age:")
print(sales_df['customer_age'].value_counts().sort_index())"}
